description: Shrink-only architecture graph ledger. Add an entry with a reason only after an architecture review; remove entries when the code shrinks.

shared_surfaces.reason: The public include/ tree and foundation/include are shared dependency surfaces, not implementation components. The current ROOT<->edge_io mutual include is a facade split (shared port headers vs aggregating SDK headers), not a component cycle.

conditional_handling: All if()/else() branches are parsed and merged. An edge that exists on only one platform still has to obey this matrix, so conditionals fail closed instead of disappearing.
